STP.note: The document states nothing on electronic authentication.
Only an electoral-roll interoperability plan with the civil registry is named, not a link to the ID system.
No count or share of people holding the BI is given.
The BI is given on reaching majority, not at birth.
The document does not say who operates or maintains the ID system beyond the registry brigade.
The planned automatic electoral register is based on civil registry database interoperability, with no mention of the ID number.

facts.fact: The Direcao-Geral dos Registos e Notariado is issuing the free Bilhete de Identidade through a brigade in Porto Alegre, Caue district, after Ilheu das Rolas, with EU-funded PReSE supplying Starlink and a generator.
